_what: Theme mode for the screen look, as DATA (read-data/look-follow-system.ts). The person's record lives under `record_key` in their workspace preferences, so every device reads the same choice: { mode, light, dark }. `light` and `dark` are the looks worn when the screen is light or dark, chosen by pressing a look (a look is light or dark by its own ground colour, look-over-time.json keep_readable.ground); a slot left empty is the first look of that kind. `modes` are the choices the Theme control offers, in order: light and dark wear their own look; automatic wears the dark one while the computer's own appearance setting is dark and the light one otherwise. A new mode is one more row, handled by `follows`: `light`, `dark` or `system`. `words` are every word the control shows; {light} and {dark} are look names.

words.automatic_note: Sync the theme with your system preference. Light: {light}. Dark: {dark}. Press a look to choose it for its kind of screen.
